ecommerce-clean-architecture

api_service Confidence: 95%

An ASP.NET Core e-commerce RESTful API implementing Clean Architecture principles, CQRS pattern with MediatR, FluentValidation, Entity Framework Core, and ASP.NET Core Identity with JWT authentication.

Primary Purpose: Provide backend API services for managing an e-commerce platform including user identity, product catalogs, categories, shopping cart lifecycles, and orders.

Architecture & Workflow

Pattern: monolith

Data Flow: Inbound HTTP requests hit ASP.NET Core Controllers in ecommerce.api -> Global ExceptionMiddleware intercepts errors -> Authenticated requests are verified via JWT Bearer middleware -> Controller dispatches Command/Query through MediatR pipeline -> ValidationBehavior runs FluentValidation -> CQRS Handler invokes Domain Specifications and Application/Infrastructure Services -> Repositories query database via EF Core AppDbContext -> Domain entities are mapped to DTO responses via AutoMapper -> ResponseHandler wraps results into standard JSON responses returned to client.

Entry Points:

  • src/ecommerce.api/Program.cs

Core Components:

  • API Layer (ecommerce.api): HTTP controllers exposing REST endpoints and routing requests
  • Application Layer (ecommerce.application): CQRS handlers, MediatR commands/queries, validation behaviors, and business services
  • Domain Layer (ecommerce.Domain): Core enterprise entities, aggregate roots, specification pattern interfaces, and enums
  • Infrastructure Layer (ecommerce.infra): EF Core AppDbContext, repositories, specification evaluators, Unit of Work, and JWT token services

Global Middlewares:

  • ExceptionMiddleware error_handling: Catches unhandled application exceptions globally and maps them into consistent API error responses
  • CorsMiddleware cors: Configures Cross-Origin Resource Sharing policy based on application options
  • Authentication & Authorization Middleware auth: Validates JWT Bearer tokens and enforces role-based identity claims on protected endpoints
  • ValidationBehavior validation: MediatR pipeline behavior executing FluentValidation validators before dispatching commands and queries

Actors & Roles

ActorRole / Permissions
Anonymous UserPublic visitor with unauthenticated access to browse products, view categories, register accounts, authenticate (sign-in), and confirm email addresses.
Authenticated CustomerRegistered customer authenticated via JWT Bearer tokens with authorization to manage shopping carts, add/remove cart items, checkout, and view order history.
AdministratorPrivileged user role authorized to create, update, and delete products and categories, inspect user accounts, and retrieve top-selling sales analytics.
